sentence: This project studies how low levels of the monosaccharide fucose affect the survival and function of limbal stem cells during inflammation.
This project builds an algorithm that uses deep learning to predict right ventricular size, function, and clinical outcome in patients with repaired Tetralogy of Fallot.
This project studies whether a sugar-binding protein called galectin-12 adds to brain inflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how binge and high-intensity drinking changes alcohol motivation and brain circuits linking the basolateral amygdala and the dorsomedial striatum in mice.
This project develops technologies to study functional genomics in living cells and to understand treatments for human health, aging, and disease.
This project supports open-source software that models blood flow and biomechanics in the heart and circulatory system.
This project develops a degrader of a nuclear receptor and tests whether it can treat melanoma in in vivo models.
This project studies the role of the fibroblast in muscular dystrophy using experiments in mice.
This project studies how sphingosine 1-phosphate acting on endothelial receptors helps host defense and limits blood clots and bleeding during respiratory viral infections.
This project provides animal models, including rodents and zebrafish, and imaging services for cancer studies.
This project builds antibody fragments and protein-based chelators to image and treat tumors that carry oncogenic mutations.
This project studies whether activating a receptor pathway can reshape macrophages so that immunotherapy works against bladder cancer.
This project develops an MRI imaging method that measures degenerative changes in muscle during aging.
This project studies how activating the integrated stress response leads to memory problems in cognitive disorders, using a mouse model.
This project tests gene therapy with Brain Derived Neurotrophic Factor in a clinical trial for Alzheimer's disease.
This project develops compounds against fungal infections that target a fungal-specific enzyme called sterylglycosidase.
This project grows rat brain tissue in mice to study how brains develop, function, and evolve.
This project builds a platform that reads the DNA of single cells in tissue while also analyzing RNA and protein.
This project studies how germline stem cells switch to meiotic development in model organisms.
